items.title: Unfinished LP settlement rejects stock deposits and withdrawals
items.description: The LP manager rejects stock deposits and withdrawals because it checks W transfers instead of U; production Wrapped LP remains unfinished.
gates: ALLOWS: Eligible owner passes ordinary pool, deadline, identity, issuer LP permission, tick and context guards; quote-only entry has zero W delta and successful Q settlement.
ALLOWS: Normal admitted stock sale reaches a positive W position delta in the retained compiled implementation. Production Wrapped LP is explicitly unfinished; no deployed victim is asserted.
ALLOWS: Another eligible unprivileged trader completes the ordinary U-to-Q sale; the LP owner then reaches the invalid W receipt check during withdrawal.
CONFIRMED: Withdrawal reverts and retains the active position/receipt. Earlier completed trade persists. Temporary payout also rolls back. Permanent loss is not proved.
items.confidence_basis: 100 minus 10 for the specified but achievable single-sided LP state.
items.scope_caveat: Compiled retained LP implementation only. Current repository explicitly defers production Wrapped LP and has no demonstrated production deployment.

fix_options.label: A — block unfinished LP entries
B — settle stocks in U and validate the LP wrapper
C — block new stock position creation
D — settle stocks in U with LP wrapper authorization and U approvals

items.title: Issuer inactivity raises the cost of legal-share conversion
items.code_smells: The adapter calls an issuer view with one loop per elapsed period; neither this view nor U transfers updates the checkpoint.
items.description: Traders repeat past fee calculations on each swap when fees apply; production settings and a failed swap remain unverified.
gates: ALLOWS: Hook requires issuer conversion for the stock delta; the reference issuer view loops once per elapsed period, and Wrapped U transfers do not checkpoint it.
UNCERTAIN: No actual admitted production issuer configuration, bounded inactivity proof, or material gas failure is supplied. The reference default zero fee skips the loop.
items.promotion: Three reused reviewers agree on the reference loop, but repeated source observations do not establish production configuration or material gas failure. Remains a LEAD under shared-rules' concrete-proof requirement.
